_comment: REFERENCE MANIFEST, NOT AN API PAYLOAD. The Insider Risk Indicators (preview) connector, custom indicator creation, and Insider Risk Management policy authoring are all portal-only workflows with no documented Graph/PowerShell write API (design.md §4). No script in this scenario's deploy/ folder reads or applies this file - it is a structured, versioned source of truth for the person completing the portal steps in README.md §5, recording the connector's CSV mapping, the custom indicator(s) created from it, and the policy trigger/scoring configuration, since none of this can be read back via any API.

connector.name: OPERATOR CHOICE - e.g. 'Third-Party CASB/DLP Detections'
connector.entraAppId: OPERATOR VALUE - the Application (client) ID from ../../departing-employee-data-theft/deploy/Register-HrConnectorApp.ps1 -DisplayName '<this connector's app>' (reused unmodified, README.md §5 Step 2)
connector.jobId: OPERATOR VALUE - generated by the Purview portal when the connector is created (README.md §5 Step 3); required by deploy/Send-InsiderRiskIndicatorRecord.ps1 -JobId

sampleFile.worked example: Microsoft's own documented multi-indicator example (import-insider-risk-indicators, Example 2): one CSV covering Salesforce and Dropbox aggregated alerts, routed via a Source column - design.md §6.

columns.UserColumn: User_Principal_Name (OPERATOR CHOICE of column name - Microsoft does not fix it; matches deploy/Send-InsiderRiskIndicatorRecord.ps1 -UserColumn)
columns.EventTimeColumn: Aggregation_Date, ISO 8601 (yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss.nnnnnn+|-hh:mm) - mandatory role, any column name
columns.ThresholdColumn: Alert_Count - OPTIONAL, must be mapped as a Number data type in the portal's 'Verify sample data and data type' step if a custom indicator built from this connector will use a threshold
columns.SourceColumn: Source_Workload - OPTIONAL, required only for the multi-indicator-from-one-CSV pattern

sourceColumnConfig.selected: OPERATOR CHOICE - 'None (Single source)' or the actual source column name
sourceColumnConfig.relatedValuesInSourceColumn: OPERATOR VALUE, comma-separated, NO spaces - e.g. 'Salesforce,Dropbox'. MUST match deploy/Send-InsiderRiskIndicatorRecord.ps1 -RelatedValues exactly and the actual values present in the CSV's source column - Microsoft: 'The connector fails if the column values don't match.'

dataMapping.eventTimeUtc: Maps to EventTimeColumn above - mandatory field in the portal's Data mapping page
dataMapping.userEmailAddress: Maps to UserColumn above - mandatory field in the portal's Data mapping page
dataMapping.additionalFieldsSelected: OPERATOR CHOICE - any other CSV columns to surface as supporting context in Activity explorer/alerts/cases (not used for triggering or scoring)

connector.firewallAllowlist: webhook.ingestion.office.com MUST be allowlisted wherever deploy/Send-InsiderRiskIndicatorRecord.ps1 runs from, or the upload silently fails to reach the service.

customIndicators.name: OPERATOR CHOICE - e.g. 'Salesforce - Sensitive Report Exfiltration (third-party)'
customIndicators.thresholdField: OPERATOR CHOICE - the mapped ThresholdColumn (e.g. Alert_Count), OR 'Use only as a triggering event without any thresholds' (mutually exclusive - selecting the no-threshold option means this indicator CANNOT be given a trigger threshold later, README.md §11)
customIndicators.usedAsTrigger: OPERATOR CHOICE - true/false, set on the policy's Triggers page, not here
customIndicators.usedAsScoringIndicator: OPERATOR CHOICE - true/false, set on the policy's Indicators page, not here

customIndicators.name: OPERATOR CHOICE - e.g. 'Dropbox - Anomalous Personal-Cloud Copy (third-party)'
customIndicators.thresholdField: OPERATOR CHOICE, same rules as above

policy.policyName: Data Leaks - Custom Indicator (Third-Party Connector) Trigger
policy.templateScopeCaveat: Confirmed (design.md §2 goal 7/README.md §11, 2026-09-28) that 'Data leaks by priority users' also supports a custom indicator as its triggering event and 'Data leaks by risky users' does not. This manifest and scenario remain scoped to the base Data leaks template only.

scope.users: A plain Entra security group (or groups), resolved via ../../security-policy-violations/deploy/Get-SecurityPolicyViolationsScopeCandidates.ps1 (reused unmodified) - identical population mechanism to both sibling Data-leaks-template scenarios in this library.
scope.note: PER-TEMPLATE cap, shared cumulatively with BOTH sibling scenarios (scenarios/insider-risk/data-leaks/ and scenarios/insider-risk/data-leaks-exfiltration-activity-trigger/) if all three are deployed in the same tenant - now a three-way shared pool, not just two.

triggeringEvent.type: Custom indicator (from the Insider Risk Indicators connector)
alternativesNotUsedHere: User matches a data loss prevention (DLP) policy - see scenarios/insider-risk/data-leaks/
User performs an exfiltration activity (built-in indicators) - see scenarios/insider-risk/data-leaks-exfiltration-activity-trigger/
triggeringEvent.selectedCustomIndicators: OPERATOR CHOICE - list which of customIndicators[] above are selected on the policy's Triggers page
triggeringEvent.thresholdMode: MUST be a custom threshold - Microsoft: 'Insider Risk Management doesn't provide recommended thresholds for custom indicators.' There is no default-threshold option to select for a custom indicator used as a trigger.
triggeringEvent.customThresholdValue: OPERATOR CHOICE - record the actual threshold value(s) entered in the portal here, since there is no read API

scoringIndicators._note: A SEPARATE decision from triggeringEvent.selectedCustomIndicators above, same two-independent-decisions model the exfiltration-activity-trigger sibling's manifest already documents for built-in indicators.

officeIndicators.note: Primary built-in scoring category for this template - identical to both siblings.

cumulativeExfiltrationDetection.note: Enabled by default for this template - confirm actually selected at policy creation.

scoringIndicators.customIndicatorsAlsoUsedForScoring: OPERATOR CHOICE - list which of customIndicators[] above (if any) are ALSO selected on the policy's Indicators page, with their own independently-configured custom threshold

syncWaitRequirement: Wait 24 hours after creating/updating the custom indicator(s) and this policy before running deploy/Send-InsiderRiskIndicatorRecord.ps1 for the first time (or after any indicator/policy change) - Microsoft: 'It can take several hours to sync all components. If you immediately upload the data while the updates are syncing, some data might not be scored for risk.'

alertReview.note: Repo default - do not disable pseudonymization without an explicit, documented privacy/legal decision. Same as every IRM scenario in this library.
